results.rationale: Section 4-2(2) requires an establishment to have the buildings, equipment, facilities and services necessary to ensure export operations comply with the Act.
Section 4-2(4)(a)(ii) mandates that an establishment be designed and constructed to provide adequate lighting.
Section 4-2(3) explicitly requires an establishment to have handwashing and toilet facilities.
Section 4-2(4)(b) requires the establishment to be designed and constructed to facilitate effective cleaning.
Section 4-2(4)(c) requires the establishment to be designed and constructed to minimise the possibility of infestation or contamination during export operations.
Section 4-2(4)(d) requires the establishment to provide for the disposal of all waste material (including liquids and solids) in an appropriate and hygienic manner.
Section 4-2(4)(a)(i) requires areas suitable for assessments, and subsection (4)(f) requires the establishment to allow samples to be taken, together covering inspection areas and sampling points.
Section 4-9(2)(a) requires screening to be carried out in a way that manages the risk of contamination by large contaminants for prescribed grain and similar products.
Section 4-9(2)(b) requires screening to ensure that any large contaminants are removed from the plants or plant products.
